verdicts.statement: A currency can be defined as a medium of exchange.
verdicts.reason: The context does not define currency as a medium of exchange.

verdicts.statement: The value of a currency is represented by a unit such as a dollar.
verdicts.reason: The context states that the dollar is a word used to represent value.

verdicts.statement: The document describes currencies as fiat currencies.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that all of our currencies are fiat currencies.

verdicts.statement: The usefulness of fiat currencies depends partly on government control of the amount of currency in circulation.
verdicts.reason: The context identifies government control of the amount of currency in circulation as one of the factors that makes fiat currency useful.

verdicts.statement: The usefulness of fiat currencies depends partly on public trust in continued demand for the currencies.
verdicts.reason: The context states that currency is useful partly because people trust that others still want more of that currency.
